desc: Analyze the problem and identify the core algorithm (Profile DP / Transfer Matrix on the smaller dimension).
Implement a function to read input and handle multiple test cases.
For each test case, if $H < W$, transpose the grid to ensure $W \le H$.
If $W$ is small ($\le 20$), use Dynamic Programming with bitmask to count valid configurations.
The DP state will track the configuration of vertical edges between the current row and the next.
Multiply the results for each row transition using matrix exponentiation if $H$ is large.
Handle the toroidal boundary condition by ensuring the first and last rows match.
Fix the logic for constructing the transition matrix T, specifically handling the horizontal boundary conditions within a row correctly.
Optimize the matrix multiplication and exponentiation to handle $W$ up to 10-12 efficiently.
Test the solution with the provided sample inputs.
